note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1952 original English description; holotype from Cururuzinho (Rio Autaz), Brazil. Measurements translated verbatim from Table 27 of the original, in millimetres. The original did not describe the alate or the worker.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Close to C. incisus, differing in the more rounded sides and posterior angles of the head, the deeper incision of the anterior margin of the pronotum, the thicker base of the frontal tube, and the left mandibular notch closer to the mandibular apex; C. weberi is smaller, with a proportionally narrower head, straighter and more parallel sides, and sharper lateral corners of the labrum. This species is one of the largest in the genus (soldier head length including mandibles, mean 5.20 mm).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale reddish brown or dull yellow, pronotum and abdomen pale yellow. Vertex with many setae and some setae below, covered with a contrasting short hair blanket; pronotum with many setae and some short hairs; posterior half of the tergites with sparse setae, lateral margins with some short hairs; sternites with setae and hairs. Head nearly rectangular, sides slightly curved, slightly narrowed anteriorly; posterior margin with a shallow median lobe, posterior angles rounded but fairly distinct at the junction of the posterior margin and the sides. Frontal tube proportionally short, overhanging the base of the postclypeus only slightly from above. Postmentum proportionally narrow relative to head width, at its narrowest slightly more than half the greatest width (0.37:0.71 mm). Antennae 15-segmented. Lateral corners of the labrum bluntly pointed or rounded, the angle at the junction with the white median lobe distinct. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave or not concave. Measurements (mm; original Table 27, n=4—11, means in parentheses): head length including mandibles 5.08—5.30 (5.20); head length to the tip of the frontal tube 3.41—3.68 (3.57); head length to the lateral mandibular bases 3.66—4.03 (3.84); head width 2.98—3.20 (3.08); head thickness 1.90—2.07 (2.00); frontal tube length 0.32—0.42 (0.37); labrum width 0.82—0.88 (0.86); left mandible length 1.68—1.86 (1.81); right mandible length from the notch 0.87—0.94 (0.90); pronotum length 0.78—0.86 (0.82); pronotum width 1.40—1.59 (1.50); hind tibia length 2.15—2.42 (2.30).
